stories.title: B-52 BOMBER VECTORING MIDDLE EAST — TRANSPONDER OFF
stories.event: KAN News reporter: a B-52 strategic American bomber detected on flight tracking sites heading from the US base in Sicily towards the Middle East. The plane turned off its transmitter — flight path unknown. This is a nuclear-capable strategic bomber, not a tactical asset.
stories.context_timeline: Earlier today (15:45-15:56 UTC): Trump press conference — alternates between 'will attack Iran hard' / 'going to hit them again hard today' and 'the deal is fully negotiated, they just need to sign' / 'want peace for the world'. At 15:51 UTC: Israeli jets over southern Lebanon and Bekaa. 16:15 UTC: Trump says US seized 22 Iranian oil ships in covert night operations.
stories.consensus: Market pricing Trump's Iran rhetoric as bluster. S&P down ~1.2% on the day. Oil elevated but not spiking. CPI data (12:30 UTC) was in-line — no Fed surprise. The consensus narrative: 'Deal is close, this is negotiating theater.'
stories.contradiction: A B-52 with transponder off heading from Sicily to the Middle East is NOT negotiating theater. B-52s are strategic bombers — they deploy to strike, not to intimidate. Turning off the transponder means operational security for a real mission. Combined with Trump's own words ('not going to say whether going to knock out bridges, power plants'), Israeli jets over Lebanon, and the admission of seizing 22 oil tankers — the US is executing a multi-axis escalation. The B-52 transponder-off is the tell the market is missing.

bet.position: LONG WTI crude, LONG VIX, SHORT SPY/QQQ
bet.instrument: CL (WTI futures), VIX futures/options, SPY/QQQ puts
bet.entry: Immediate — B-52 signal is 10 min old
bet.rationale: When the B-52 vector becomes public market knowledge (it's already being reported), oil spikes $3-5/bbl, equities dump 2-3%, VIX surges. The consensus is positioned for a deal — this breaks that thesis.

benefit.volume_impact: VERY HIGH — cross-asset flight to safety, oil volume surge on supply disruption premium

stories.title: IRAN OIL FLOW NORMALIZING — 2M BPD MOVING vs MARKET NARRATIVE OF TOTAL BLOCKADE
stories.event: Rapidan Energy Group reports ~2 million barrels/day of oil and related products now flowing out of the Persian Gulf. Over the weekend off Oman, 16 tankers clustered to transfer millions of barrels of stranded oil. Trump admitted seizing 22 Iranian ships in covert operations. Iran struck Bahrain and Jordan with missiles/drones in retaliation (05:13 UTC). US strikes hit Iran in response to Apache shoot-down (01:00 UTC).
stories.consensus: Iran is crippled by the blockade. 'Nothing gets through.' Iran is a failed state. The Hormuz blockade is 'the most successful in naval history.' Oil premium is justified by supply disruption.
stories.contradiction: 2M bpd is flowing — that's not a total blockade. 16 tankers cluster-trading off Oman means the secondary market is functioning. Trump bragging about seizing ships while 2M bpd flows means either: (a) the blockade is leaky and oil is getting through via non-Iranian Gulf producers, or (b) Iran is selling through intermediaries. Either way the 'total blockade' narrative is propaganda, not fact. If the market realizes supply is flowing, the oil risk premium deflates. But simultaneously — B-52 heading to theater means new strikes, which re-inflates it. Net: extreme oil vol, direction depends on which story dominates next.

bet.position: LONG oil vol (options straddle), directionally LONG crude
bet.instrument: WTI weekly options straddle, CL futures
bet.entry: Immediate — vol is cheap relative to binary event risk
bet.rationale: Two contradictory forces on oil (flow normalization + escalation). The straddle captures whichever breaks first. If B-52 strikes happen: oil explodes higher. If deal announced: oil dumps. Directional bias LONG because escalation risk dominates.

benefit.vol_directional: Oil implied vol +10-15 points in 1-2 hours
benefit.volume_impact: EXTREME — binary event on oil, gamma squeeze potential

stories.title: ISRAEL-LEBANON — JETS OVER BEKAA + LEBANON AIRSTRIKES
stories.event: Israeli jets over southern Lebanon and the Bekaa Valley area. IAF launched airstrike in Bekaa Valley (15:23 UTC). Earlier (Jun 7 previous cycle): IDF Tyre evacuation, Nabatieh push. This was flagged as expanding front risk previously.
stories.consensus: Israel-Lebanon front is a sideshow to Iran. Market barely pricing it.
stories.contradiction: If the US is about to bomb Iran hard (B-52, Trump statements), Israel opening a Lebanon front simultaneously creates a TWO-FRONT escalation in 24 hours. Iran's proxies (Hezbollah) are already engaged. A B-52 strike on Iran + Israeli ground op in Lebanon = regional war, not contained strikes. The 'sideshow' narrative breaks if both happen.

bet.position: LONG VIX, LONG oil, LONG gold
bet.rationale: Two-front escalation risk is underpriced. If B-52 mission confirmed + Israel hits Lebanon simultaneously, it's a regional war premium repricing.

benefit.volume_impact: HIGH — gold breaking out on geopolitical risk premium
